objective.title: Twenty-four more functions' tests cover their edge cases
criteria: Each of the 24 listed modules has tests for empty input, boundaries, both call forms and the lazy path where one exists
No change to src/*.ts outside the test files
The runtime tests and the type check pass on every accepted checkpoint

tasks.title: Edge cases for addProp
tasks.brief: Extend packages/remeda/src/addProp.test.ts with runtime tests for cases it does not yet cover: overwriting an existing key, adding to an empty object, a value of undefined, that the input is not mutated, and the data-last form. Read addProp.ts and the existing tests first. Add only tests that pass against the current behaviour; change no other file.
